To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we introduce a translation accuracy based feature for Phrase Based Statistical MT systems and show that it leads to significant improvements in translation quality.

we introduce a novel translation quality-based phrase scoring feature that improves translation quality by a statistically significant margin, and that our method achieves this improvement with a substantial reduction in memory and time requirements.

we introduce a new feature for PB SMT, based on the edit distance between oracle phrase pairs and phrase pairs occurring on a baseline system's N best list, and that this feature improves translation quality, reduces memory use and increases speed.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the use of translation quality as a feature in PB SMT, and we demonstrate that it is possible to use such features in order to improve translation quality, while reducing phrase table size, and increasing system speed.

the development and evaluation of an accuracy based feature to PB Statistical Machine Translation, and the demonstration of the effectiveness of this feature on a number of MT evaluation metrics, including the development of a method to reduce the phrase table size while maintaining the gains in translation quality achieved by the addition of this feature.

our feature is an effective and efficient way of improving translation quality for PB SMT.

we have developed an approach for improving the translation quality of a phrase based statistical translation system by incorporating an accuracy based feature.
